title: Lis310 - Records Management And Archives Administration
modules: Arrangement And Description Of Archives (Part Two)
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic unit of administrative control of archival collections."
Series (Class) is the basic unit of administrative control of archival collections.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital aspect of records management."
Disposal of records is a vital aspect of records management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means as long as the record is viable, as long as the record is useful and useable."
Retention schedule means as long as the record is viable, as long as the record is useful and useable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the place where we preserve records of enduring value."
Archives as we already know is the place where we preserve records of enduring value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term assigned to the entire unabridged body of records produced by, and used in, a single recording system."
Series is the term assigned to the entire unabridged body of records produced by, and used in, a single recording system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a corporate memory of an institution, a society or even a state."
An archive is a corporate memory of an institution, a society or even a state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the skill or practice of leading, controlling, planning, or directing something or somebody."
Management is the skill or practice of leading, controlling, planning, or directing something or somebody.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form designed in the archive."
Accession Form / Log Accession form is a form designed in the archive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the starting point of every profession and Library and Information Science is not exempted."
Theory is the starting point of every profession and Library and Information Science is not exempted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a proposal of income and how it would be spent."
Budget is a proposal of income and how it would be spent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a criminal offence and violator(s) can be charged."
Piracy is a criminal offence and violator(s) can be charged.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of archival practices."
Arrangement of archival material is an important aspect of archival practices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body responsible for safe guarding national archival materials."
The National Archives of Nigeria is the body responsible for safe guarding national archival materials.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a body of manuscript in a manuscript archives."
A manuscript group is a body of manuscript in a manuscript archives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key driver in increasing an organization's effectiveness by reducing the time employees spend searching for information. 2."
Records management is a key driver in increasing an organization's effectiveness by reducing the time employees spend searching for information. 2.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the oral account of events."
Oral history is the oral account of events.

sub-group

vertical file cabinets

Caution and patience
Caution and patience are the best attributes of a professional archivist.

good leader

Consistency
Consistency means continuous, without changing.  Integrity - The veracity of a record is when the record is presented complete and unaltered and there are no fake copies in circulation.
According to the course material, how many types of guides are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of guides:  Primary guide : This is a divider that identifies a main division of file; it always precedes all other material in a section.  Special guide: This helps in identifying an individual, subject or organization's records.
